note: One entry per fact a human player has access to, in the sense of the reward loop's obs axis (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-29-reward-loop-and-seed-agent-design.md §6). `where` names the engine-side accessor a bot could read the fact from, or null when no accessor exists. `exposed` records whether a bot view actually carries it today; the ratchet in checklist_test.go MEASURES each flag from the observation path and fails on any disagreement in either direction. Adding a fact carrier without recording it here fails; a recorded true fact regressing to false fails. This ticket measures only -- it exposes nothing new.

facts.description: The viewer's own library as an unordered list of cards, without its secret order.
The viewer's own deck archetype, as a prior over what the deck is trying to do.
facts.where: deck.File.Archetype (parsed from the deck file; deck.Manifest does not carry it, so view.View.OwnDeck loses it)

facts.description: A posterior over an opponent's archetype, inferred from the cards revealed about that opponent.
facts.where: view.PlayerView.Archetype (*view.ArchetypePosterior), inferred in view/archetype.go from the seat's public battlefield/graveyard/exile/command lists

facts.description: The viewer's own mana curve over its decklist.
facts.where: deck.Manifest.Curve (derived at genesis by CurveOf from Main's front-face CMCs; view.View.OwnDeck projects it)

facts.description: Per-player counts for each zone: library, hand, graveyard, battlefield and exile.
facts.where: view.PlayerView (LibrarySize/HandSize/GraveyardSize ints plus the Battlefield/Exile/Graveyard card slices)

facts.description: The bot router answers every decision kind the engine can pose (a human answers them all).
facts.where: botpolicy/policy.go decide(): a routing site per decision.Kinds entry

facts.description: The viewer's own hand as a list of cards.
The viewer's own genesis decklist (card names and counts), known before the first draw.
Floating mana in every player's pool (public under CR 106.4a/106.4b/117.3d/118.3a).
